written_before: any computation on DPANN (no run, no score, no timing)

method.name: MDL vocabulary over MMseqs2 tokens (stage 1 control)
method.input: rescue3 MMseqs2 family tokens + gene order (universe gid order); lineage unit emb_hom average theta 0.75 (642 groups)
method.adjacency: two live symbols X != Y on one contig with <= 2 intervening single (terminal) genes; unordered; strand ignored
method.gain: Lambda = n ln(n/E) - n + E nats, n = lineage groups with >= 1 occurrence, E = sum over groups of 1 - prod over its genomes of (1 - min(1, 6 c_X c_Y / m_g)), live counts
structural_rules: symbols present in < 2 groups are background (cannot reach n >= 2)
method.update: rounds; candidates n >= 2 & Lambda >= tau applied in decreasing Lambda; occurrences claim nodes (distance then position); commit only if claimed occurrences keep n >= 2 & Lambda >= tau; until nothing commits
method.stop: tau = smallest value of the ladder [4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 70, 100] with word-type FDR = mean(null word types over shuffles 1000-1002) / observed word types <= 0.01; null = tokens permuted within each genome (engine genome null, contig sizes kept). Gene-level FDR reported, not used.

readings.V-top: top-level word instances, span first to last gene inclusive (inserted genes included); single level
readings.V-nest: V-top plus the spans of the children of each top-level instance that are word instances (one level down)
readings.V-mob: V-top plus, within each top-level instance, the maximal sub-instances whose word type also occurs as a top-level instance in >= 2 groups
readings.primary_selection: between V-nest and V-mob on ODD genomes by (number of odd conditions met, odd summed DF+TXSS excess) against token DH on odd; recorded in NOTEBOOK.txt before any even score of a vocabulary output
readings.V-top_role: single-level reading, reported against token R1 and token DH

arms.reference: GTDB genus (same procedure, own null-calibrated tau); reference only
arms.diagnostic: every genome its own unit (descent correction off), same procedure, own tau; reported if run time allows

reference_reproduction: rescore $RD/boundary/loci/rescue3/DH_coreH_res0.3_f0.5.parquet with blib.score_table and blib ribosomal functions; must give even summed DF+TXSS excess .4270, F1 .744/.548/.479, ribosomal 1,686 recovered / 1,512 resolved, Parvarchaeaceae 113/114 resolved, before any vocabulary comparison

evaluation.bootstrap: paired genome bootstrap, 2,000 draws, seed 17 (rules.paired / ribo_paired)
evaluation.matches: summed excess >= DH - 0.01; each caller F1 >= DH - 0.02; ribosomal recovered >= 1,650, Parvarchaeaceae recovered >= 110/114, resolved >= 1,400
evaluation.beats: matches and summed-excess difference lower CI bound > 0

H1.claim: the selected nested vocabulary reading matches token DH on even genomes
H1.refuted_if: any matches bar fails on even genomes

H2.claim: group-level counting is what makes the objective work: the every-genome-its-own-unit arm loses >= 0.02 summed excess against the main arm (same reading)

H3.claim: word identity types gold systems at least as well as the engine's module labels: AMI(word type, DefenseFinder system_type) >= AMI(engine module, system_type) on the same covered gold instances (even genomes)

H4.claim: the null-calibrated tau lies within a factor 2 of the a-priori MDL cost of naming one rule, 2 ln(number of symbols) nats

expectations_written_before_numbers.V-nest_vs_DH: neither matches nor beats is the more likely outcome (about 65%); likely blockers CRISPR-Cas F1 (rare Cas pairs fall under n >= 2 groups at 642 groups) and ribosomal resolved (words absorb conserved flanks); summed excess within -0.05..+0.05
expectations_written_before_numbers.V-top: ribosomal recovered >= 1,650 (runs form one word); summed excess between token R1 (.3375) and DH (.4270)
expectations_written_before_numbers.typing: word types finer than gold types: homogeneity above modules, completeness below; AMI similar

stage2: to be predeclared as an amendment after the stage-1 verdict and diagnosis, before any stage-2 computation

amendment_stage2.written_after: stage-1 even verdict (neither; blockers CRISPR-Cas F1, ribosomal) and diagnosis 1 (exact identity fragments units and word types); before any stage-2 computation (no alphabet built, no run)
amendment_stage2.alphabet: vocabulary tree of zca10 ESM++ small vectors of unique sequences (softrec transform), nested spherical k-means: level 1 K = 1,024; each cell split into up to 16 (level 2), each of those into up to 8 (level 3); a cell of n sequences gets min(B, n // 4) children; seed 17. A unit is a cell, its prototype the normalised member mean. Genes without a vector are background at every level. No MMseqs2 family, no taxonomy.
amendment_stage2.learner: vocab2.py: as stage 1 with three labels per live node. Terminal labels = its units at levels 1-3; a unit present in < 2 groups is background at that level. A word node's label at level l = the canonical id of the unordered pair (child labels at level l) (its projection; background if either child is). Keys: for an adjacency of two terminals, all 9 level pairs (each slot picks its own radius); for an adjacency involving a word, the 3 same-level pairs. Keys compete for nodes in decreasing Lambda (same gain, same commit rule); a committed key is a word type.
amendment_stage2.reproduction_check: vocab2.py with one label level (MMseqs2 tokens) must reproduce vocab.py at tau 10 (identical word table up to symbol renumbering and identical instance spans) before any stage-2 run
amendment_stage2.stop: tau ladder [6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 30]; same rule (smallest tau with word-type FDR <= 0.01 over 3 genome shuffles of the label rows)

readings.V-phr: V-top + phrases: maximal runs of consecutive top-level words on a contig, each junction (<= 2 genes apart) carrying a flanking-gene unit pair (same level, any level) with n >= 2 groups and Lambda >= tau in the round-0 statistics of the same run. Two levels (phrase, word), the analogue of DH's neighbourhood + core. Designed after the stage-1 even verdict (the ribosomal deficit).

amendment_stage2.selection: primary between V-mob and V-phr on ODD genomes by (odd conditions met, odd summed excess) against token DH; recorded before any even stage-2 score
amendment_stage2.post_hoc_label: V-phr applied to the stage-1 token vocabulary is computed as an attribution control and labelled post hoc (stage-1 even numbers were already seen)
amendment_stage2.criterion: matches / beats token DH as in stage 1; plus paired difference against the stage-1 vocabulary under the same reading

S2-H1.claim: the stage-2 selected reading matches token DH on even genomes

S2-H2.claim: embedding units relieve unit fragmentation: CRISPR-Cas member genes left free (in no word) fall from 41% to <= 25%, and CRISPR-Cas F1 rises >= +0.03 against stage 1 under the same reading (even)

S2-H3.claim: with V-phr the Parvarchaeaceae ribosomal runs are recovered (>= 110 of 114)

S2-H4.claim: the summed-excess gain of stage 1 over token DH survives the change of alphabet: stage-2 summed excess >= token DH + 0.10 under the selected reading (even)

amendment_stage2.expectations: tau* 10-15 (more keys per adjacency); V-phr selected; ribosomal recovered >= 1,650 and resolved 1,100-1,500; CCT F1 between stage 1 (.406) and token DH (.479); verdict 'neither' more likely than 'matches' (about 60/40), with CRISPR-Cas the most likely blocker

amendment_ablation.written_after: stage-2 odd scores (V-mob selected; stage 2 below stage 1 on odd summed excess); before any stage-2 even score
amendment_ablation.label: diagnostic (designed after stage-2 odd numbers); not a verdict arm

arms.vt1k@2: finest vocabulary-tree level alone (125,588 cells): embedding units at one resolution

amendment_ablation.procedure: same learner and null rule; ladder tau in [8, 10, 12] with 3 shuffles; tau* = smallest with type FDR <= 0.01; reading V-mob; odd then even; paired against stage 1 (tokens) and stage 2 (all levels) under V-mob
amendment_ablation.question: does the coarse (kind-level) resolution cost the summed excess and TXSScan F1 that stage 2 loses against stage 1?
amendment_ablation.expectation: vt1k@2 is within 0.03 summed excess of stage 1 (embedding units at family scale behave like MMseqs2 families); adding the coarse level lowers summed excess by about 0.08
amendment_ablation.refuted_if: vt1k@2 summed excess (even, V-mob) more than 0.05 below stage 1, or vt1k@12 not above full vt1k
